heading: About Me
summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications across enterprise, business, and e-commerce domains. Experienced in managing the complete development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and planning application architecture to development, testing, deployment, and production support.
body: Experienced in developing scalable applications, improving application performance, implementing secure workflows, and delivering reliable solutions with a focus on usability and maintainability. Worked on projects from initial development through production release, collaborating with teams to deliver features, resolve issues, and maintain application quality. Also experienced in mentoring junior developers and interns and supporting them throughout the development process.
